description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveEmpty' that extends 'HTMLPurifier_Injector'. The class is responsible for handling HTML tokens and removing empty elements during HTML purification, including the removal of whitespace and non-breaking spaces based on configuration. It contains methods for preparing the injector with configuration and context, and handling individual HTML tokens to determine whether they should be removed.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveEmpty
classes.description: A class responsible for removing empty HTML elements during the purification process, with specific handling for whitespace and non-breaking spaces based on configuration.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector with configuration and context, setting up parameters like removal of non-breaking spaces and predicate exclusions.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Processes individual HTML tokens to determine if they are empty and should be removed, respecting configuration and attribute validation.
